bio.text: Jaha Howard, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia Senate in December 2025 and represents District 35, which includes parts of Cobb and Fulton counties.
Howard is a board-certified pediatric dentist who owns A+ Pediatric Dentistry of Atlanta, and served four years on the Cobb County Board of Education.
Howard earned a B.S. in Chemistry and a Doctor of Dental Surgery from Howard University and a master's in oral sciences from the University of Illinois at Chicago in 2009, and lives in Smyrna.
